linkedin.title: The way we search for news is shifting from hunting for links to asking for answers.
linkedin.body:
For decades, we have been trained to search for keywords and then sift through a list of blue links to find the truth. It is a slow, manual process that relies on us doing the heavy lifting to connect the dots between different reports.

AI search is changing that dynamic. Instead of just pointing you to a source, technology can now synthesize information from across the web to give you a direct, nuanced answer. It is a fundamental shift from search as a retrieval tool to search as a knowledge partner.

But this brings a new responsibility. When an AI summarizes the news for you, the quality of the answer depends entirely on the quality and diversity of the sources it reads. If the AI is fed a narrow slice of information, your answer will be biased or incomplete. That is why we are building Headlinne to prioritize transparency and source credibility above all else.

The future of news consumption isn't just about getting an answer faster. It is about getting a better, more reliable answer that respects your time and your intelligence.

slides.headline: Flavio Bolsonaro claims title of Brazil's leader
slides.subtitle: He lost the recent election to Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva.

slides.explanation: The election results were final, yet this declaration challenges the established outcome of the national vote.

slides.headline: The claim ignores the official election results
slides.explanation: While Flavio Bolsonaro insists he leads the country, he was defeated by his opponent in the official run-off election.
Five major international news outlets have confirmed the election results and the subsequent statements made by Flavio Bolsonaro.

slides.subtitle: Read more about the political climate in Brazil on Headlinne.

instagram.caption:
Brazil's political landscape is currently seeing a strange moment.

Flavio Bolsonaro has publicly referred to himself as the leader of the country, despite losing the recent presidential election to Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva.

This claim stands in direct opposition to the official electoral results. It highlights a growing divide in the political rhetoric coming from those who lost the vote.

When politicians make claims that contradict official election data, it can cause confusion for the public. We track these stories to help you see past the noise.

story_card.headline: Chancellor announces £100 energy bill support
story_card.standfirst: The government's first budget aims to tackle the cost of living crisis.

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: Chancellor Healey announced a £100 payment for energy bills and a new tax on banks.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: The move comes as the government tries to manage the ongoing cost of living crisis.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Economic turmoil is hitting households hard. This budget is the government's first major response.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Critics argue the plan lacks boldness. Watch for upcoming debates on its effectiveness.

story_card.caption:
The UK government has unveiled a new budget featuring a £100 payment to help with energy bills.

Chancellor Healey is targeting the cost of living crisis with this new support package, funded in part by a bank tax. Opposition parties have already criticized the measures, arguing the government has not been bold enough to fix the current economic turmoil.
